I'll try to clarify a few of the questions from yesterday.
An Aristocrat can turn merchant or serf, but does lose all the benefits and responsibilities of being an aristocrat.

Normally, it is more difficult to be accepted into the ranks of nobility, but Cato has done so by marriage. While you gain the benefits and responsibilities of the aristocracy, you will likely be looked down upon by the more blue blooded.
There is no minimum gold for an Aristocrat. Many nobles put on a show of wealth while also being completely broke.
I was just concerned with everyone budgeting for 4000 when we're selling for at least 7500

Leaving the aristocracy, however, is not looked at kindly, and is a scandal. When you leave to become a merchant or serf, you must abdicate your remaining wealth to the mayor or town council, and leave in shame.
As for prices....
The crafting cost in "sane magical prices" is the cost required to craft the item. Labor is needed above and beyond that cost.
